summary: Possible sister of Johann Casper Doll (speculative); links Dolls, Sorbers and Croops.
bio: Maria Engel Doll, b. 15 Sep 1717 at Ulmet, d. 1785, married Jacob Sorber in 1739; their son Abraham Sorber (b. 1744) went from Northampton to Hanover Twp, Luzerne, and his daughter Elizabeth Sorber married John Croop. If Maria Engel was Casper's sister, the Sorbers and Croops who built the Hunlock's Creek sawmills were already cousins.
